segmentation.text: shall keep as far to the right of the highway
shall not form two lanes of traffic
unless the highway is marked for four or more lanes of traffic.

elements.justification: "Stopping" (DEF-NRS-484A-260) is "any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle"; that it is required is read through the devices in the scene that require a halt of the subject's traffic: dev.railway_signal_or_gate, "the devices at a level crossing; lights in {flashing, dark}; gate in {up, lowering, down, raising, none}", with lights flashing or the gate lowering or down; dev.stop_sign, "regulatory sign requiring a full halt"; dev.traffic_signal showing circular_red; dev.human_direction with indication stop and role police_officer or railroad_flagger. Each must govern (dev.governs, "the travel regions whose traffic the device controls") a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies, "a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region"). dev.governs is "not a stand-in for a position": the place of the stop is not read from governance but from s2's distance to the crossing. dev.traffic_signal is not a sign; the signal's state is read, not a sign's.

st.railway_crossing: "level crossing of a railway with the roadway, and its nearest rail"; "railroad" (DEF-NRS-484A-200) is "a carrier of persons or property upon cars, other than streetcars, operated upon stationary rails": a level crossing of a railway with the roadway is a railroad crossing, and a streetcar line laid along the street forms no level crossing of a railway with the roadway, so the definition's exclusion is already made by the contract. The subject is at the crossing where st.region_geometry, "the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it (zero when they overlap)", is within p.railroad_crossing_approach_reach; region_geometry is not a stand-in for occupancy, and no occupancy is read from it.

"Driver" (DEF-NRS-484A-080) means "every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle": the duty binds the conduct of a vehicle, the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ("every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway"); ru.aggregate is not a stand-in for the relational role of who drives, which is read through the vehicle's controlled motion (observable_reading, agency).

The right of the highway the subject is on: st.highway "the entire public way between its boundary lines" occupied by the subject (rel.occupies); st.road_edge "curb or edge of the roadway" lying on that way (st.on_way, "the public way a structure region lies on"); the edge is on the subject's right where prim.region_lateral_offset, "the signed lateral offset (m, left positive) of a structure region from a road user", is negative. st.on_way is not nearness to a way: the edge's belonging to the way is read from the relation, not from distance.

operationalizations.standard: as far to the right of the highway as possible
operationalizations.convention: A vehicle kept as far right as it can be placed stands with its body within the curb clearance of a parallel-parked car plus lane-keeping variability and an edge margin of the right-hand edge of the roadway: the ground distance from its body to a road edge on its right (st.region_geometry, prim.region_lateral_offset negative) is at most p.pullover_edge_gap. A vehicle in any lane but the rightmost, or wandering left within the rightmost, is farther.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle; its body is within p.railroad_crossing_approach_reach of a railroad crossing c (st.railway_crossing, st.region_geometry); and some device d governs (dev.governs) a travel region r whose footprint the subject overlaps (rel.occupies) and requires a halt of r's traffic at this observation: a dev.railway_signal_or_gate whose lights are flashing or whose gate is lowering or down, a dev.stop_sign, a dev.traffic_signal displaying circular_red, or a dev.human_direction of role police_officer or railroad_flagger with indication stop.
obligation: At every such observation, some st.road_edge e lies on a highway h the subject occupies (st.on_way(e, h), rel.occupies(subject, h)), lies to the subject's right (prim.region_lateral_offset(subject, e) < 0), and the ground distance from the subject's body to e (st.region_geometry) is at most p.pullover_edge_gap. Where no such edge is found the duty is violated; where the offset or the distance of every candidate edge is unobserved, unknown.

narrowings.why: "the driver" is read through the vehicle's controlled motion; whoever or whatever controls it.
That a device is official, placed by a public authority or railroad, is read from its presence.
"the right of the highway" is read as the right-hand edge of the roadway; a shoulder beyond that edge is not a place the vehicle is required to move onto.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Railway signal lights flashing and gate down govern the two-lane approach of a one-way roadway; the subject car halts 8 m from the railway crossing in the left lane, its body 4.5 m from the right-hand road edge (prim.region_lateral_offset negative), farther than p.pullover_edge_gap.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A stop sign governs the subject's lane 10 m from a railway crossing on a two-lane two-way highway; the subject car halts straddling the centre line, its body 2.5 m from the right-hand road edge.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same crossing and flashing lights; the subject car halts 8 m from the crossing in the rightmost lane, its body 0.4 m from the right-hand road edge.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject car is 8 m from a railway crossing whose lights are dark and gate up; no stop sign, red signal or stop direction governs its lane.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Lights flashing govern the subject's lane near a crossing; the source maps regions without their outline, so the distance to the crossing and to the road edge is unobserved.

param_proposals.name: p.railroad_crossing_approach_reach
param_proposals.convention: the ground distance from a vehicle's body to a railroad grade crossing within which the vehicle is at the crossing, on the stretch where a halt for the crossing is made: the 50-ft outer bound of the zone in which grade-crossing practice places the halt before the nearest rail
param_proposals.source: MUTCD Part 8 highway-rail grade crossing stop-line placement and the Uniform Vehicle Code grade-crossing stop zone

param_proposals.name: p.pullover_edge_gap
param_proposals.convention: the gap between a vehicle body and the right-hand curb or roadway edge within which a vehicle pulled over to clear the way counts as as close to the edge as it can be placed: the curb clearance of a parallel-parked car (about 0.3 m) plus lane-keeping variability and an edge margin
param_proposals.source: parallel-parking curb clearance and lane-keeping variability in naturalistic driving data
